facts: KFB Law, personal injury, Tampa. Listing address 3128 W Kennedy Blvd, Tampa, FL 33609. The Tampa page prints 3128 W. Kennedy Blvd. Tampa, FL 33609. Site phone 813-875-5445 and 1-813-875-5445. Email marcus@kfblaw.com. Listing phone (813) 694-1621. Page URL https://kfblaw.com/tampa-personal-injury-lawyer/.

The page says consultations are available 24/7 and offers a free consultation. It says no win, no fee. It also says that for a limited time attorney fees are lower than the standard fees established by the Florida Bar. It claims 30+ years of combined experience and 38 years of KFB Law.

Practice headings on the page include car accident, slip and fall, motorcycle accident, truck accident, wrongful death, dog bite, neck and back injury, traumatic injury, insurance disputes, product liability, premises liability, hospital and nursing home abuse, backover and driveway accident, boating accident, pedestrian accident, and hurricane claims.

The page says the office serves Tampa, Town 'n' Country, Ybor City, Carrollwood, and Port Tampa, and that it sits between the Westshore Business District and Downtown Tampa, near I-275, the Lee Roy Selmon Expressway, the Veterans Expressway, and HART bus stops, with parking spots.
Other location pages exist for St. Petersburg and Riverview. Those are separate listings. No weekly door hours were printed on the Tampa page we read.
